question: Does the darkturquoise module eigengene differ across all three groups (ctrl, bp_nolith, bp_lith), and does any group difference survive composition adjustment?
rationale: Analyses 001-006 used only 226 BP samples. Darkturquoise (140 genes, ribosomal, loading=0.455 on PC2) drives the lithium-composition signal in BP. We now extend to all 474 samples to ask: (1) Does darkturquoise also track cell composition in controls? (2) Is there a group difference in darkturquoise after adjusting for composition?
pre_specified_tests: Pearson r(darkturquoise_ME, b2) in each group separately
LM: darkturquoise_ME ~ group + b1 + b2 + b3 + b4 (composition-adjusted ANOVA)
Pairwise: ctrl vs bp_nolith, ctrl vs bp_lith, bp_nolith vs bp_lith (t-test, Bonferroni 3 comparisons)
